summary: refactor(settings): tighten metricsContext and flowQueryParams types
description:
## Because

- A double cast on `flowQueryParams` stops the compiler from checking that argument.
- `queryParamsToMetricsContext` already accepts a typed `QueryParams`, so the casts are not necessary.
- Two import paths for `MetricsContext` resolve to the same file, and one page declares its own duplicate alias.

## This pull request

- Removes the `flowQueryParams` casts at the `queryParamsToMetricsContext` call sites.
- Removes the orphaned `searchParams` import in `Signin/container.tsx`.
- Deletes the local `MetricsContext` alias in `InlineTotpSetup/interfaces.ts`.
- Imports the shared `MetricsContext` from `@fxa/shared/metrics/glean` in all touched files.
- Changes no runtime logic.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-9687
